description.en: Dissorophus multicinctus: whole-organism living environment prop. Nominal 0.45m length, soft tissue volume, tail endpoint, distal limbs, digits, palette and pose are conservative art. Photo is incomplete skull/trunk armor; not a complete specimen reconstruction. Broad transverse arched internal/external armor layers overlap above each other, unlike narrow Cacops armor; no exact internal spinal flange claim.
